description.zh: 设备采购和项目收入币种错配可能压缩利润。
description.en: Currency mismatch between equipment procurement and project revenue can compress margins.

mitigation.zh: 采用自然对冲、分段报价和汇率调整条款。
mitigation.en: Use natural hedging, staged pricing, and FX adjustment clauses.

description.zh: 跨省项目的土地、环境和施工许可节奏可能不同。
description.en: Land, environmental, and construction permitting pace may vary across provinces.

mitigation.zh: 尽早聘请本地法律和许可顾问，设置审批里程碑。
mitigation.en: Engage local legal and permitting advisors early and set approval milestones.

description.zh: 群岛电网和局部负荷限制可能影响项目消纳。
description.en: Archipelago grid structure and local load constraints may affect project absorption.

mitigation.zh: 在可研中加入电网接入、储能配置和调度场景分析。
mitigation.en: Include grid access, storage sizing, and dispatch scenarios in feasibility studies.

description.zh: 代理商、EPC 或服务商能力不足会影响交付和回款。
description.en: Weak distributors, EPCs, or service providers can affect delivery and payment collection.

mitigation.zh: 设置试单、背景调查、付款担保和分阶段授权。
mitigation.en: Use trial orders, background checks, payment security, and phased authorization.

description.zh: 土地、林地、矿区和社区沟通处理不当会延误项目。
description.en: Poor handling of land, forestry, mining-area, and community engagement issues can delay projects.

mitigation.zh: 开展环境社会尽调，保留社区沟通记录。
mitigation.en: Conduct environmental and social due diligence and keep community-engagement records.
